hooks.name: Security review trigger
hooks.description: When authentication, permissions, tenancy, storage or upload code changes, prompt a review against the security steering.

action.prompt: Security-sensitive code changed (auth, permissions, tenancy, storage or upload). Review the change against .kiro/steering/security.md before continuing: JWT algorithm pinned and expiry enforced; refresh rotation and reuse revocation intact; every tenant query runs in a tenant session (SET LOCAL app.current_org via bound parameter) and filters organization_id; cross-org access returns 404; permissions come from require_permission, not inline role checks; uploads use magic-byte detection, size and ZIP limits and traversal rejection; storage keys are server-generated and org-prefixed and originals are never overwritten; no secrets, tokens or document text are logged; no SQL is built with string formatting. Report any issue with file:line and fix critical or high issues now. For a full independent review, delegate to the security-reviewer agent.
